Samantha —

Appreciate the clear asks. High level response and proposed next steps below; attaching a draft addendum and our chain‑of‑custody process for your review.

Summary (short):
- Artifacts: signed release manifest (SHA256), vendor‑signed binary bundle (GPG), delivery receipt, and a signed acceptance form after installation.
- Delivery options: encrypted removable media via vetted courier OR sealed transport drive handed to your on‑site admin. We also support offline SFTP for signed packages if connectivity is allowed.
- Timeline: standard lead time is 5 business days from signoff; can do an expedited (48–72h) ship with premium courier.
- Support model: 24x5 phone + on‑call for critical release failures; escalation to our Platform Ops (Marcus Lin) and Director of Support (Lauren Bishop).

Proposed next steps:
1) We fill the SIG_Addendum_Request_Form and return by EOD Fri (attached).
2) Agree on shipping vendor — we can work with GlobalSecure Logistics (preferred) or use your local carrier.
3) Create a one‑page runbook for the pilot (installation checklist + post‑install verification).

Deliverables attached: Redwood_OnPrem_SIG_Addendum_v1.pdf, ChainOfCustody_Process.md

If that looks good, I’ll loop Marcus for the signed manifest schema and Hannah to confirm ops windows.

Subject: Re: SIG addendum — manifest schema & security controls for physical delivery

Hi all,

Adding a few technical constraints and the minimal schema we will provide to satisfy SIG evidence requirements:

- All media shipments will include: manifest.yml (with per‑file SHA256), GPG detached signature of manifest, courier chain‑of‑custody form (signed at each handoff), and an acceptance PDF signed by your admin upon install.
- Hash algorithm: SHA256; manifest format is YAML (schema attached).
- For high‑security customers we can sign manifests with an HSM key; otherwise we use our standard GPG signing key with rotation logs.
- Retention: Redwood keeps copies of manifests and shipping receipts for 3 years; metadata stored in immutable audit logs (read‑only).
- Escalation: if a checksum mismatch is detected at install, the local admin should quarantine media and contact Platform Ops immediately (pager + escalation to Security). We’ll dispatch a replacement and an investigation.

I attached manifest_schema.yml. Marcus will be the escalation contact for Platform Ops.

— Marcus Lin
Platform Security — Redwood Inference
